pythonFunction.name: submit_meter_read
pythonFunction.description:
Submits a meter reading for the next bill. A reading far outside the expected range is held
until the customer reconfirms it, then submitted with a billing-review flag. Needs an
authenticated caller. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while
it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    reading: The meter reading the customer gave (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.
    reconfirmed: True only after the customer confirmed an unusual reading a second time.

Returns:
    dict with ok, submitted, confirmation_number, billing_review_flag and
    needs_reconfirmation. The same reading submitted twice in one session returns the first
    confirmation with duplicate_suppressed true.
